## Description
Please include a summary of the changes and the related issue.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] DevOps / CI/CD pipeline update
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Unit tests added / updated and passing (`mvn test`)
- [ ] Selenium end-to-end journeys verified (`mvn test -Pselenium`)
- [ ] Multi-stage Docker image builds cleanly (`docker build -t healthsure .`)
- [ ] Docker Compose orchestration verified (`docker compose up -d`)
- [ ] Actuator health check returns HTTP 200 (`/actuator/health`)

## Screenshots (if applicable)
Add screenshots of UI changes or test execution evidence.
